stories.title: No. 1 Texas rides stout defensive performance to hold off No. 14 Vols
stories.summary: Colin Simmons tied the program record with five sacks as top-ranked Texas held off No. 14 Tennessee 20-17 on Saturday in the Longhorns' first visit to Neyland Stadium.

stories.title: Horns' Simmons flagged for miming urinating on field after sack vs. Vols
stories.summary: Texas star defensive end Colin Simmons apologized for drawing an unsportsmanlike conduct penalty for 'simulating using the restroom' in the first half of Saturday's win at Tennessee.

stories.title: Emotional Verlander leaves final start with hugs from family, teammates
stories.summary: Justin Verlander got an unexpected hook in his major league finale, when the 7-year-old daughter of the pitcher and model Kate Upton came to the mound.

stories.title: Sources: Bulls trading Dillingham to Hornets for Hield
stories.summary: The Chicago Bulls are trading Rob Dillingham to the Charlotte Hornets for Buddy Hield and cash, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania on Saturday.

stories.title: Bears QB Williams out for MNF; Bagent back at practice
stories.summary: Bears QB Caleb Williams is out for Monday's game against the Eagles, and backup Tyson Bagent returned to the practice field while still in the concussion protocol.
